title: Love Live! School idol project - Love wing bell
description:
Insert song from Love Live! S2E05, where Rin Hoshizora takes the center. Suitable for starry levels and special scenes.

This port loops at the first verse for the purpose of making it play indefinitely. The MML file is cross-compiled from a different MML dialect using a custom Lua script, and then manually optimized.
